integrity: Proof includes explicit small-cycle rational expressions, Green-kernel asymptotics, an exact negative six-cycle entry and certified Fourier-tail bounds; independent mathematical verification has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns simple unit-edge undirected cycles, completed two-stage Gauss endpoint steps, and all \(h\ge0\). Intermediate stages and arbitrary irregular or weighted networks are outside its scope. The common timestep \(h=8\) is a witness, not claimed minimal. Publication priority beyond inspected primary texts and retrieved public summaries is not established.
title: Five-vertex positivity boundary for fourth-order Gauss graph-heat steps on cycles
